findings.detail: The DNAnexus First Lien Term Loan identifier uses 12/18/2029 from the adjacent delayed-draw instrument, but its own source row states 12/20/2029.

rationale: Class 2 source-row comparison shows the structured XBRL maturities are correct and the identifier-derived dates are defective. DNAnexus has two distinct instruments: the delayed draw is 12/18/2029 (table 13 row 48), while the flagged First Lien Term Loan is 12/20/2029 (table 13 row 49). Cherry Bekaert current-quarter rows are 6/30/2030 (table 14 rows 26-30), whereas 6/28/2030 appears in the comparative schedule (table 21 rows 30-34), proving comparative-period leakage into all three flagged identifiers.
